Platform Components

Understanding Commons

From collective grazing grounds to community water sources, commons are the lifeline of rural India. They act as essential safety nets, provide livelihoods, and house rich biodiversity. This component helps users understand the ecological and socio-economic significance of shared resources.

Latest updates Published: Our Commons Report 2024 - Celebrating CommoningMost Recent New map layer: Significance of Commons geospatial visualizer
Explore Component

Commons Stories

Empowering communities through shared resources and sustainable practices. Through hundreds of verified rural impact stories mapped directly on our spatial visualizer, we document the transformation and resilience of communities.

Latest updates Cultivating Sustainability: Journey from Agriculture to AfforestationMost Recent Preserving Lawachara: Community-Led Biodiversity Conservation
Explore Component

Village Institutions

Village institutions play a pivotal role in governing common-pool resources. This database makes these institutions discoverable so that development programmes can work towards strengthening them.

Latest updates Over 15,000 village communities now mapped in the databaseMost Recent Platform update: Institutional Strength assessment tool live
Explore Component

Commons Explorer

Explore various dimensions of commons through decision support tools, AI-powered insights, thematic maps and an array of geospatial datasets. Make your own maps and dashboards using open datasets.

Latest updates Dataset upgrade: Latest land use and land cover maps via GeoServerMost Recent Featured Map: Distribution of Commons Lands in the country (1991-2011)

Facilitating Commoning

We provide training materials and specialized IT-enabled tools that address specific needs at the grassroots. These resources are free to use, proven at scale, and support multiple languages.

Latest updates Training module launched: Prakriti Karyashala materials on sustainable agricultureMost Recent Tool update: Offline data collection capabilities enhanced for remote fieldwork

Legal Repository

The legal repository houses critical documents including the Forest Rights Act and Supreme Court summaries on grazing lands. It provides the legal frameworks necessary for practitioners to advocate for secure governance.

About Commons Platform

Enabling Collective Action for Commons

The Commons Platform is a shared digital infrastructure that brings together data, technology, and people to strengthen the governance of natural resources. It enables communities, practitioners, and governments to plan, act, and make decisions collectively using reliable data and shared tools.

Commons Platform Components

The Commons Platform is a Digital Public Infrastructure developed by FES to empower the ecosystem of stakeholders working to conserve commons across the country.

It brings together data, technology, and people to strengthen the governance of natural resources such as land, water, and forests. It enables communities, practitioners, and governments to plan, act, and make decisions collectively using reliable data and shared tools.

The Need for a Unified Platform

Access to data on natural resources is often fragmented, complex, and difficult to use, particularly for those working closest to the ground.

The Commons Platform addresses this gap by making data simple, accessible, and actionable. It connects diverse stakeholders—from community leaders to policymakers—enabling evidence-based planning.

Sustainable Livelihoods

Empowering rural families with resource data to secure their future.

Ecological Resilience

Tools to monitor forest health and groundwater levels in real-time.

Social Equity

Democratizing access to technology for marginalized collectives.

How It Works

A unified ecosystem for learning, coordination, and action.

Democratize Data

Making socio-economic and ecological data usable for diverse stakeholders through intuitive interfaces.

Build Knowledge

Capturing oral epics, community stories, and shared experiences to inspire and inform action.

Connect Institutions

Linking partners and village institutions to design interventions that are culturally and ecologically grounded.

Ground Action

Supporting on-ground interventions through specialized tools, training, and long-term program enablement.

Admin Hierarchy Microservice

9 endpointsGET & POSTJSON responsesState to Village

Core administrative boundaries and geographical hierarchy integration API endpoints for state-to-village level mapping. This service is essential for any spatial analysis requiring accurate administrative context across the Indian subcontinent.

Our Partners

We believe in contributing to an 'ecosystem organisation' wherein organisations with like-minded interests share data, analytics and tools, so that they can make a lasting impact. We realize that organisations are by their very design focussed on certain elements, functions or themes and that it is in the joining of hands between such organisations and initiatives that we could hope to make a reasonable impact.
